dict.string: Aran Terminal needs microphone access so command-line tools you run in the terminal (voice recording, transcription, AI voice agents) can capture audio.
Aran Terminal needs camera access so command-line tools you run in the terminal can capture video.
Aran Terminal needs speech-recognition access so command-line tools you run in the terminal can transcribe speech.
Aran Terminal needs access to your Desktop so command-line tools you run in the terminal can read and write files there.
Aran Terminal needs access to your Documents folder so command-line tools you run in the terminal can read and write files there.
Aran Terminal needs access to your Downloads folder so command-line tools you run in the terminal can read and write files there.
Aran Terminal needs Photos access so images you drag from Photos into the terminal can be read by the command-line tools you run there.
Aran Terminal needs access to removable drives so command-line tools you run in the terminal can read and write files there.
Aran Terminal needs access to network volumes so command-line tools you run in the terminal can read and write files there.
Aran Terminal needs network access so command-line tools you run in the terminal can connect to the internet (APIs, git, package managers).
Aran Terminal needs Bluetooth access so command-line tools you run in the terminal can communicate with nearby devices.
